# score-kernel 02-qualification

End-to-end qualification vectors (scoring-port-contract §2): every reward kind's thresholds/caps/dedups with window-boundary cases (24h view dedup at the exact second, permille 850/849, the integer tab-hidden rule, 7d demo dedups, the trailing-30-min exploration bound incl. the inclusive edge), the FOUR signature statuses (unsigned / verified / invalid / unregistered incl. post-revoke) with real P-256 signatures over real cores, per-epoch composition (raw cap 20, streak bonuses, pre cap 22) and one exclusion verdict applied through the kernel. Replay `records` in seq order against `device_key_events` + `exclusion_weights`; your per-event verdicts and per-user days MUST equal `expected` exactly. Windows run on `received_ts`; days are `epoch_id`.
